scripts.build:zomes: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p mpc_integrity -p mpc
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.test:sweettest: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p mpc --test mpc_network -- --nocapture && cargo test -p mpc --test dkg_live -- --nocapture && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --test three_processes -- --nocapture
scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:sweettest
scripts.test:native: npm run test:core && npm run test:security && npm run test:policy && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:frost && npm run test:worker-unit && npm run test:ipc-process && npm run test:dkg-durable && npm run test:worker-restart && npm run test:node-service
scripts.test:dkg-live: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p mpc --test dkg_live -- --nocapture
scripts.test:dkg-process: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --test three_processes -- --nocapture
